description:
Mint a durable single-use capability lease, or attenuate a parent lease.
    Use before an irreversible action you may need to retry: pass a stable use_nonce to
    vc_lease_consume so a retry after a timeout blocks instead of writing twice.
    Authority is conserved — a child's uses are reserved out of the parent, so a 1-use grant
    cannot father N free children. ~$0.05/call.

action_scope.description: Space-separated scope atoms the lease grants, e.g. 'read:repo write:issue'.
action_scope.title: Action Scope

holder.description: Agent the authority belongs to. Use '*' for any holder.
holder.title: Holder

max_uses.description: How many times this authority may be spent (1..10000).
max_uses.title: Max Uses

parent_lease_id.description: Attenuate from this parent: child scope must be a subset, and its uses are transferred out of the parent.
parent_lease_id.title: Parent Lease Id

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE if not using X-Vibes-Key.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

ttl_seconds.description: Seconds until expiry. Secondary check only: the ledger is the authority.
ttl_seconds.title: Ttl Seconds

name: vc_lease_issue
